description: Implement the Employee Edit Form at /employees/[id]/edit. This form pre-fills all fields from the existing employee data and allows updating via Supabase .update(). Follow the exact same form structure as src/app/employees/new/page.tsx (same sections: Identite, Emploi, Contact, Adresse, Anciennete & Remuneration) but fetches existing data on mount and uses update instead of insert.
steps: Create src/app/employees/[id]/edit/page.tsx as a 'use client' component that: (1) Fetches employee by id using createClient() from @/lib/supabase/client on mount, (2) Pre-fills all form fields with existing data, (3) Fetches sectors and locations for dropdowns just like the new form, (4) Uses the same form sections/layout as src/app/employees/new/page.tsx (Identite, Emploi, Contact, Adresse, Anciennete & Remuneration), (5) On submit calls supabase.from('employees').update(payload).eq('id', employeeId), (6) Shows success feedback and redirects to /employees/[id] detail page, (7) Includes error handling and loading states, (8) Has a 'Retour' link to /employees/[id] and an 'Annuler' button
Add a 'distance_to_home' and 'notes' field to the edit form (these exist in the schema but are missing from the new form)
Ensure all labels and UI text are in French
The detail page at src/app/employees/[id]/page.tsx already has a Link to /employees/[id]/edit (the Pencil icon) so no additional linking is needed
acceptance_criteria: The page at /employees/[id]/edit renders a form pre-filled with the employee's current data

All 25+ fields from the employees table are editable (title, first_name, last_name, date_of_birth, nationality, national_registration, job_title, contract_type, date_of_hire, end_date, sector_id, location_id, is_inactive, email, mobile_phone, business_phone, home_phone, address, postal_code, city, province, country, granted_seniority, granted_seniority_date, inami_number, iban, bic, distance_to_home, notes)
Submitting the form updates the employee in Supabase and redirects to the detail page
npm run build passes with the new page
verification: npm run build passes without errors
findings: Build passes cleanly. The edit form is at /employees/[id]/edit with all fields pre-filled from existing data. distance_to_home placed in the Adresse section, notes in its own section at the bottom.
